newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* Philippine shares are likely to remain weak as negative local sentiment and the steep fall in Wall Street last Friday will put investors on the defensive, brokers said.
* Bing Trinidad, research manager of DBS Securities, said he expected shares to move sideways to lower with immediate support seen in a range of 2,800 and 2,850.
"At these levels, the market valuation will be 17 times 1997 earnings. Investors may come in to pick up some bargains," he said, but that added any rally would be capped by profit-taking.
